name: Findmyshift
summary: Findmyshift charges per team, not per user: a free plan for 5 team members, then $24 (20 members), $38 (100) and $75 (300) a month on yearly billing, or $27, $43 and $85 on monthly billing. Every new account gets a 3 month trial with all features. Availability handling is thinner than shift swaps and time off.

facts.text: Plans are priced per team: Free covers 5 team members and 1 manager, Starter 20 members, Business 100 and Enterprise 300.
The pricing page says all features are free for the first 3 months, with no credit card required.
The scheduling tour says employees can request shifts, submit cancellations and swap shifts, but it does not say employees can set their own availability.
The terms allow refunds only for future dates and only to the original payment card, and they do not address data export after termination.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed yearly ($286 a year); $27 on monthly billing. 20 team members, 1 manager

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Billed yearly ($459 a year); $43 on monthly billing. 100 team members and managers

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed yearly ($904 a year); $85 on monthly billing. 300 team members and managers

hiddenCosts: The trial is stated as 3 months on the pricing page, shown here as 90 days.
Starter allows only 1 manager, so a team with several schedulers needs Business.

contract.cancellation: Accounts can be cancelled at any stage, started by the customer after an identity check. Refunds cover future dates only.
